# PolyTranscript
> Multi-platform transcription API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for YouTube, TikTok, and Podcasts.

## Available Tools & URLs
- Homepage / Universal Transcriber: https://polytranscript.com
- YouTube Transcript Generator: https://polytranscript.com/youtube-transcript-generator
- YouTube Shorts Transcriber: https://polytranscript.com/youtube-shorts-transcript-generator
- YouTube to SRT Converter: https://polytranscript.com/youtube-to-srt-converter
- TikTok Transcript Generator: https://polytranscript.com/tiktok-transcript-generator
- TikTok Captions Extractor: https://polytranscript.com/tiktok-captions-extractor
- Podcast to Text Transcriber: https://polytranscript.com/podcast-transcript-generator
- Spotify Podcast Transcripts: https://polytranscript.com/spotify-podcast-transcript-generator
- MP3 to Text Audio Converter: https://polytranscript.com/mp3-to-text-converter
- Developer API & MCP Documentation: https://polytranscript.com/docs
- Pricing & Sponsor Slots: https://polytranscript.com/pricing
- API Key Dashboard: https://polytranscript.com/api-keys

## Key Features
- Free, instant, sub-second transcript extraction (under 200ms latency).
- Direct export to Markdown, SRT, VTT, JSON, and LLM Prompt.
- Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude Desktop and Cursor.
- Public Serverless API: POST https://polytranscript.com/api/transcribe
